outfit.name: 重樱烈焰金鱼华服
outfit.prose: Sakura Empire imperial carrier attire: an opulent vermilion red and obsidian black kimono dress with billowing gold-trimmed sleeves, trailing phoenix brocade, deep plunging cleavage revealing heavy bust, daring high hip slit, wide black and gold obi sash, and red lacquer geta heels
